title: Chat
input_placeholder: Ask ChonkPilot... (Enter to send on last empty line)
screenshot_no_vision: The selected LLM does not declare the "Vision" capability, so screenshot is unavailable (enable it in Settings → LLM → Model Capabilities)
clear_confirm: Are you sure to clear all conversation history?
error_timeout: Request timed out: the service did not respond in time. Please retry later.
error_network: Connection failed: cannot reach the service. Check the network or whether the service is running.
error_auth: Authentication failed ({status}): invalid API key or insufficient permission. Check Settings → LLM and retry.
error_rate_limit: Too many requests ({status}): you are being rate limited. Please retry later.
error_protocol: Invalid request: the protocol or parameters are incorrect. Please check and retry.
error_process: Command failed: the process exited with a non-zero status. Check the raw output for details.
error_disk: Out of disk space: free up space and retry.
error_permission: Permission denied: cannot access the file or directory. Check permissions and retry.
error_db: Session data error: this turn's records could not be saved or read. Please retry.
error_tool_loop: Tool call limit exceeded: this turn was stopped automatically. Adjust the task and retry.
error_unknown: An unknown error occurred. Please retry, or expand "Raw error" below for details.
delete_session_confirm: Are you sure to delete this session?
select_subsession: Select a sub-session to view its conversation
tool_background_ok: Moved to background, you can continue other operations
timeout_arbitrate: Tool "{tool}" has been waiting {seconds}. Choose how to proceed
confirm_delete_session_msg: Are you sure to delete session #{id}?
rename_prompt: Enter a new name for this session
copy_session_dialog: Copy conversation (no system; full dialogue, not compressed; json-array)
session_copy_empty: This session has no dialogue to copy
ask_user_busy: Question timed out, the AI has continued on its own; your reply will be sent as a new message
load_more_failed: Failed to load earlier messages. Scroll up to retry.
ask_user_cancel_answer: This question is complex, terminating the task first to discuss it later
empty_reply: Empty reply: the model returned no content. Click Continue to resend.
no_llm_configured: No LLM configured. Please configure a model in Settings.
no_llm_selected: No LLM selected. Please choose a model.
llm_model_missing: The selected LLM is missing a model. Please check Settings.
llm_setup_failed_hint: This message failed to send. If no usable LLM is configured (or the current provider is unavailable), add or check a provider (endpoint / model / API key) under Settings → LLM, then retry.
new_chat_window: Open chat in a new window (new session; up to 5 windows)
open_in_new_window: Open this session in a new window
activate_chat_window: Already open in a new window (click to activate it)
chat_window_main_active: This session is the main window's active session; it cannot be opened in a new window
chat_window_limit: Window limit reached (max 5) — close one and retry
chat_window_open_failed: Failed to open the chat window
prompt_empty: No prompts in the knowledge base
